management_notes: Management execution has shown meaningful cracks: in May 2026 Churchill issued a formal correction to previously disclosed Frost Cove drilling results due to 'internal data compilation discrepancies.' For a single-project explorer whose primary asset is its data, this is a material QA/QC failure. It does not appear to have changed the headline intercepts (7.25% Sb / 1.98m and 6.44% Sb / 2.06m remain cited in corrected form), but the error erodes confidence in the rigour of internal controls. On the positive side, management moved quickly to correct and disclose, and execution on the Golden Baie option (TSXV approved March 27, 2026, shares issued to Canstar, exploration program launched) was orderly. Insider ownership remains opaque from available public data. Score lowered to 2 from 3 reflecting the data-integrity lapse; a clean drilling disclosure going forward would support a return to 3.
geology_notes: Black Raven's 2025 maiden drill program confirmed high-grade antimony mineralisation at Frost Cove with corrected results including 7.25% Sb over 1.98m and 6.44% Sb over 2.06m near the Southern Shaft along ~800m of strike. A second polymetallic system (gold-silver) was identified at Taylors Room, and a gold-silver-lead-zinc system at Pomley Cove Pond, demonstrating district-scale potential. The 2026 two-rig program — Rig 1 started March 23, Rig 2 mid-April — is targeting Frost Cove extensions and Pomley Cove Pond, so assay results should be flowing through mid-2026. Golden Baie (29 licences, 39,925 ha) adds a second large exploration footprint with systematic geophysics and drilling planned for 2026. The 2023 NI 43-101 technical report on file does not contain a formal resource estimate for Black Raven — compelling intercepts are real, but no compliant resource exists, which caps the geology score.
capital_notes: With 316.7M shares issued and 342.8M fully diluted, Churchill carries a large share structure for an early-stage explorer with no NI 43-101 resource. The 15,834,097 shares issued to Canstar Resources as the initial consideration for the Golden Baie option (TSXV-approved March 2026) are included in the outstanding count from the April 2026 interim MD&A. Options outstanding (23.45M) represent ~7.4% dilution from current issued; warrants are modest at 2.625M with no strike/expiry detail available. No flow-through tranches were detected in the most recent filing, though the NL exploration tax credit makes FT financing common for this class of issuer — any 2026 financing for the two-rig drill program would likely carry FT tranche risk. Two active exploration programs require continued equity financing; dilution pressure is structural at this stage.
catalyst_notes: The catalyst pipeline is dense for the second half of 2026: (1) Assay results from the two-rig 2026 drill program at Black Raven (started late March) should be flowing now — Frost Cove extension holes and the new Pomley Cove Pond target; (2) Results from systematic exploration at Golden Baie (trenching, channel sampling, airborne geophysics) expected through the year; (3) Antimony's designation as a critical mineral in Canada and the US creates potential for government grants (NRC-IRAP, federal critical mineral programs), strategic partnerships, or offtake discussions that could rapidly re-rate; (4) The corrected Frost Cove disclosure has already been absorbed — the next drill result is a clean-slate newsflow event; (5) Beaver Brook Antimony Mine (~100km south, China Minmetals, care and maintenance) as a latent corporate acquirer if CRI delineates resources.
acquisition_notes: Without an NI 43-101 resource estimate on either Black Raven or Golden Baie, P/NAV analysis is not possible. Comparable antimony M&A transactions in North America are rare, making precedent benchmarking difficult. The qualitative strategic case — consolidated NL antimony district, proximity to Beaver Brook's historic mill, Western supply-chain urgency — is real but not quantifiable at this stage. The data-correction episode also temporarily reduces the appeal to a technical acquirer performing due diligence. Score remains 2 until a compliant resource is delineated.
analyst_summary: Churchill Resources remains one of a handful of TSXV-listed primary antimony explorers in Canada at a time when the metal is designated critical in both Canada and the US. Its consolidated Newfoundland footprint — Black Raven plus the newly optioned Golden Baie (39,925 ha) — covers a district with proven historical production at Beaver Brook and high-grade 2025 drill intercepts at Frost Cove (7.25% Sb / 1.98m, corrected). A two-rig 2026 drill program is underway, targeting Frost Cove extensions and the newly discovered Pomley Cove Pond gold-silver-lead-zinc system — the real-time newsflow from this program is the primary near-term catalyst. The May 2026 data-compilation error is a management credibility ding and warrants continued monitoring; the disclosure was made promptly and headline grades held up in correction. Rate WATCH: the antimony supply-chain narrative and active drill program justify attention, but position sizing should remain speculative until a formal NI 43-101 resource is filed. A move to BUY requires a compliant resource and cleaner data governance.
